name: 24531 · Chatham, VA
findings: ZIP 24531 (Chatham) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24531 (Chatham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24531 (Chatham) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
